items.name: kinetic
items.title: Kinetic UI styles
items.description: Skeuomorphic material skin: design tokens, base styles, and data-slot skins for the Kinetic UI registry. Wrap your app in an element with class `ui-kit` (plus `dark`/`light`) and import `@/styles/kinetic/kinetic.css` in your global stylesheet.
